summary: Iteration 32 — Dress Me no-context prompt fix verified. Backend GET /api/dressme/context is auth-gated (401 without bearer), returns {has_context:false, source:null} when no plan and no calendar, and flips to {has_context:true, source:'plan', label:<title>} after creating a today-plan via POST /api/plans (cleaned up in-test). Frontend: with reviewer account (review@aureve.app) and no plan for today, Dress Me does NOT auto-generate — it shows the 'What are you doing today?' prompt (testID dressme-activity) with all nine chips (Work / Day off / Shopping / errands / Lunch / casual outing / Evening / dinner / Date / Event / Staying home / Other) and no dressme-item-0 rendered. Tapping the Work chip hides the prompt and fires POST /api/dressme with body containing occasion="Work"; Other reveals dressme-activity-other-input; empty submit does nothing (no POST); submitting 'gallery opening' fires POST with occasion="gallery opening". Source review of app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx confirms the three guards (generate() early-return when !activity && !hasContext.current, .catch() → setAskActivity, chooseActivity('Other') opens input without calling generate). Regression covered by pytest: dressme generation leaves items' wear_count/last_worn unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: AsyncStorage web shim in this Metro build is in-memory (localStorage stayed empty after login/onboarding). Not a product bug — cosmetic for automated web testing only; production native builds use SecureStore/AsyncStorage-native. If future web automation needs persistence across page.goto reloads, the test agent should navigate via in-app tabs rather than hard reloads.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (prompt + chip + Other + empty-submit + POST occasion verified)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral plan created and deleted inside test_plan_for_today_returns_true_with_source_plan; any pre-existing today-plan on seeded (test-session-token-aura-123) and reviewer accounts is deleted at the top of context tests to guarantee empty state. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright login flow on this Metro/web env: (1) tap welcome-get-started, (2) tap onb-skip-0, (3) fill login-email/login-password (review@aureve.app / AureveTest2026), (4) click email-submit. On this environment AsyncStorage is in-memory only, so navigate via tab bar (get_by_text('Dress Me')) rather than page.goto reloads to keep the bearer alive. Backend suite: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration32_dressme_context.py -v` (10s, 5 passed).
